objective.statement: Learn six strong words: forza, deciso, risoluto, pesante, marcato and energico.
successCriteria: I know forza means force and pesante means heavy.
I know deciso and risoluto both mean decided and bold.
I know marcato means emphatic and accented, and energico means energetic.

explanation.text: Six words ask for strength. Forza is force. Deciso and risoluto are about being firm and bold. Pesante is heavy. Energico is full of energy. Marcato is about touch: every note is marked out clearly.
“forza” means force, strength. “deciso” means with determination. “risoluto” means bold, strong and resolute. “pesante” means heavy.
Marcato: emphatic and accented. “energico” means energetic.
Deciso means with determination and risoluto means bold, strong and resolute: they are close in meaning. Marcato (marc.) means emphatic and accented.

music.textAlternative: A two-bar melody in G major marked pesante.

explanation.caption: Pesante above the first bar: heavy, with weight in every note.

explanation.text: Force: forza. Firm and bold: deciso, risoluto. Heavy: pesante. Full of energy: energico. Every note stressed: marcato.

music.textAlternative: A two-bar melody in G major marked risoluto.

steps: Look at the word above the first bar: risoluto.
It means bold, strong and resolute: play with firm confidence.
It does not change the speed: only the way the notes are shaped.
